label: Restoring trust in vaccination: listening to patients and acknowledging Post-Acute COVID Vaccine Syndrome.
summary: The National Academies of Science, Engineering, and Medicine (NASEM) has defined Long COVID as "an infection-associated chronic condition (IACC) that occurs after SARS-CoV-2 infection and is present for at least 3 months as a continuous, relapsing and remitting, or progressive disease state that affects one or more organ systems."
